templates.name: Decision brief
templates.job: Help a small review group choose one bounded direction and own the next step.

story_roles.purpose: Name the decision, audience, desired outcome, and current context.
Expose the author-defined constraints that make the choice real.
Compare only the alternatives supplied by the author.
State the tension the decision must accept and the evidence still needed.
End with an owner, a bounded action, and a review date.

templates.activation_gate: Launched: browser, CLI, and API compile the same author-owned fields without a provider.

templates.name: Project alignment
templates.job: Align sponsors and delivery owners on scope, dependencies, risks, and the next review gate.

story_roles.purpose: Name the project goal, audience, and why alignment is needed now.
Put in-scope and out-of-scope work side by side.
Expose dependencies and owners instead of implying frictionless delivery.
Make risks, evidence gaps, and the next review date explicit.

templates.activation_gate: Dormant until observed alignment sessions show this job is the highest-value second workflow.

templates.name: Proposal
templates.job: Help a buyer review a bounded approach, alternatives, scope, proof, and approval step.

story_roles.purpose: Frame the buyer's stated problem and desired outcome without invented research.
Explain the proposed approach, scope, and exclusions.
Compare alternatives and keep evidence claims visibly author-owned.
State the terms, owner, approval step, and review date.

templates.activation_gate: Dormant until consented proposal reviews establish safe commercial fields and a stable decision arc.

templates.name: Incident retrospective
templates.job: Review a synthetic or permissioned incident without blame, hidden uncertainty, or unsupported causality.

story_roles.purpose: State what happened, who is reviewing it, and the author-confirmed impact.
Separate the observed timeline and known evidence from interpretation.
Keep unknowns visible and describe contributing conditions without claiming root-cause certainty.
Assign bounded actions, owners, and a review date.

templates.activation_gate: Dormant until privacy, blame-safety, and evidence-language checks are validated in consented retrospectives.
